paper_title: More Communication Lower Bounds for Information-Theoretic MPC
statement: In this paper we showed two classes of lower bounds for information-theoretic multiparty computation. For the case of active security, we have show the bound for a reactive functionality. It remains open whether a similar bound can be shown for (non-reactive) secure function evaluation.
